//go:build linux && (amd64 || arm64)

package text

import (
	"github.com/ebitengine/purego"
	"testing"
)

func TestOrbitFractionalDefaultContextAndHintMetrics(t *testing.T) {
	var round func(uintptr) int32
	var opts func(uintptr) uintptr
	var hint func(uintptr) int32
	bind := func(lib, name string, target any) {
		h, e := purego.Dlopen(lib, purego.RTLD_NOW|purego.RTLD_GLOBAL)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		sym, e := purego.Dlsym(h, name)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		purego.RegisterFunc(target, sym)
	}
	bind("libpango-1.0.so.0", "pango_context_get_round_glyph_positions", &round)
	bind("libpangocairo-1.0.so.0", "pango_cairo_context_get_font_options", &opts)
	bind("libcairo.so.2", "cairo_font_options_get_hint_metrics", &hint)
	s := orbitFractionalSystem(t)
	e := s.eng.(*pangoEngine)
	for _, setting := range []string{"none", "full", "slight"} {
		s.SetFontRendering("gray", setting, "rgb")
		for _, on := range []bool{false, true, false, true} {
			s.Shape(Params{Text: "12345", Style: Style{Family: "Orbit Mono", Size: 12.5, OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions: on}})
			if round(e.context) != int32(gTrue) || hint(opts(e.context)) != cairoHintMetricsOn {
				t.Fatal("shared context changed")
			}
		}
	}
	// A separately owned context carries only the narrower rounding choice.
	c := pangoLib.fontMapCreateContext(e.fontMap)
	defer pangoLib.gObjectUnref(c)
	e.orbitApplyOptions(c, false)
	if round(c) != int32(gFalse) || hint(opts(c)) != cairoHintMetricsOn {
		t.Fatal("opt-in altered hint metrics or failed fractional setting")
	}
}
